alias: Music: make sure the Kitchen and HomePod stop
description: When a pause, play/pause or stop for the Kitchen Echo or the HomePod (the Whole House group's members) leaves it still playing 3 s later, stops the Whole House group and pauses the speaker again, then powers it off if it is still playing. Whatever sent the command: the Show's buttons, voice, a script. On 2026-11-04 a switch from Whole House to Kitchen, with a play tap in the middle of the move, left Music Assistant counting the Kitchen as a group member while it played its own queue; it redirected every pause and stop for the Kitchen to the idle group ('Player Kitchen is synced or grouped and can not accept playback related commands itself') and Hotel California played on for three minutes. Stopping the group freed it. A play/pause tap on a speaker that was not playing is ignored. Source: ha-dashboard/automations/music_pause_watchdog.json
